# Project: Sir.G Tutors
Tagline: "The Learning Solution". A tutoring website for students and tutors.

## Tech rules
- Use only plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript. No React, no frameworks.
- Backend is Supabase (will be added in later phases).
- Never put secret keys or service_role keys in any code file.
- Keep code simple, well commented and beginner friendly.
- Make every page mobile friendly (responsive).

## Design colors
navy #0d3b66, cream #faf0ca, yellow #f4d35e, orange #ee964b, red-orange #f95738

## Working rules
- Read the files in /docs before making big changes.
- Work on one task at a time. Do only what I ask in the prompt.
- Do not delete or rewrite files I did not mention.
- Explain in simple words what you changed.
